title: Dwelling policies: DP-1, DP-2, DP-3 and their add-ons
summary: Compare the three ISO dwelling forms, their coverage letters A to E, key exclusions, theft options and the endorsements the exam tests.
objectives: Tell DP-1, DP-2 and DP-3 apart by perils and loss settlement
Match dwelling Coverages A to E, and know liability needs the PLS
Pick Broad or Limited Theft by who lives in the dwelling
Spot key exclusions and the main dwelling endorsements

scenes.title: Dwelling policies: DP-1, DP-2 and DP-3
scenes.subtitle: ISO forms: 1988 DP-1 and DP-2, 2002 DP-3, plus the Personal Liability Supplement

beats.text: Dwelling forms can insure a 1- to 4-family residential building. Unlike homeowners forms, they include no liability coverage at all.
beats.say: Dwelling forms can insure a one to four family residential building. Unlike homeowners forms, they include no liability coverage at all.

beats.text: In this lesson, DP-1 and DP-2 are the 1988 editions. DP-3 is the 2002 edition, and its numbers match the 2014 edition.
beats.say: In this lesson, D P one and D P two are the nineteen eighty eight editions. D P three is the two thousand two edition, and its numbers match the twenty fourteen edition.

scenes.title: Three forms: Basic, Broad, Special
scenes.src: ISO DP 00 01 07 88; DP 00 02 07 88; DP 00 03 12 02 (Perils Insured Against; Loss Settlement)

columns.name: DP-1 Basic (1988)
points: Vandalism and malicious mischief: extra premium

columns.name: DP-2 Broad (1988)
points: 16 named perils on A, B and C
Buildings: replacement cost if insured to 80%

columns.name: DP-3 Special (2002)
points: Open perils on A and B
Buildings: replacement cost if insured to 80%

scenes.tell: DP-1 is a short named list, DP-2 a long named list, DP-3 open perils on the buildings.

beats.text: DP-1, the Basic Form, covers fire or lightning and internal explosion. Extended Coverage perils, like windstorm or hail, need their own premium. So does vandalism. Losses are paid at actual cash value.
beats.say: D P one, the Basic Form, covers fire or lightning and internal explosion. Extended Coverage perils, like windstorm or hail, need their own premium. So does vandalism. Losses are paid at actual cash value.

beats.text: DP-2, the Broad Form, covers 16 named perils on Coverages A, B and C.
beats.say: D P two, the Broad Form, covers sixteen named perils on Coverages A, B and C.

beats.text: DP-3, the Special Form, covers the dwelling and other structures for any direct physical loss not excluded. Personal property stays on a named list.
beats.say: D P three, the Special Form, covers the dwelling and other structures for any direct physical loss not excluded. Personal property stays on a named list.

beats.text: DP-2 and DP-3 pay buildings at replacement cost if they are insured to at least 80% of replacement cost.
beats.say: D P two and D P three pay buildings at replacement cost if they are insured to at least eighty percent of replacement cost.

scenes.q: Under the 2002 DP-3, which coverages are insured on an open-perils basis?
scenes.why: DP-3 covers the dwelling (A) and other structures (B) for direct physical loss unless excluded. Personal property (C) is covered for named perils only.

beats.text: Quick check. Under the 2002 DP-3, which coverages are open perils? Pick an answer.
beats.say: Quick check. Under the two thousand two D P three, which coverages are open perils? Pick an answer.

reveal.text: Coverages A and B only. The buildings get open perils, but personal property stays named perils. No DP form covers contents on open perils.
reveal.say: Coverages A and B only. The buildings get open perils, but personal property stays named perils. No D P form covers contents on open perils.

scenes.title: Dwelling coverage letters
scenes.src: ISO DP 00 03 12 02, Coverages A–E; DP 00 01 07 88; DL 24 01 12 02, Coverages L–M
items: Other structures, set apart by clear space
Fair rental value of the rented part
Liability and medical payments: PLS only

beats.text: A is the dwelling and attached structures. B is other structures, set apart by clear space. C is personal property on the Described Location.
beats.say: A is the dwelling and attached structures. B is other structures, set apart by clear space. C is personal property on the Described Location.

beats.text: Now the trap letters. D is fair rental value: rent you lose on the part you rent out. E is additional living expense: your own necessary increase in living costs.
beats.say: Now the trap letters. D is fair rental value: rent you lose on the part you rent out. E is additional living expense: your own necessary increase in living costs.

beats.text: Liability isn't in the forms. The Personal Liability Supplement adds Coverage L, personal liability, and Coverage M, medical payments to others.
beats.say: Liability isn't in the forms. The Personal Liability Supplement adds Coverage L, personal liability, and Coverage M, medical payments to others.

scenes.title: A landlord's lost rent
scenes.src: ISO DP 00 03 12 02, Coverages D–E (same wording in DP 00 03 07 14)
scenes.story: Dana rents out a house she owns in Lansing, insured under a DP-3. A covered fire makes it unfit to live in, and her tenant stops paying rent during repairs. Which coverage pays Dana's lost rent?

items.label: Damage to the house
items.detail: Coverage A pays for the repairs

items.label: Lost rent
items.detail: Coverage D: fair rental value, less expenses that do not continue

items.label: Not Coverage E
items.detail: E pays the insured's own extra living costs, and Dana doesn't live there

scenes.answer: Coverage D, Fair Rental Value. The payment period is not cut off by the policy's expiration.

beats.text: Dana rents out a house she owns in Lansing, insured under a DP-3. A fire makes it unfit to live in, and the rent stops. Which coverage pays her lost rent?
beats.say: Dana rents out a house she owns in Lansing, insured under a D P three. A fire makes it unfit to live in, and the rent stops. Which coverage pays her lost rent?

beats.text: Coverage A repairs the house. The rent is fair rental value, less any expenses that do not continue while it's unfit. Coverage E doesn't fit: Dana doesn't live there.
beats.say: Coverage A repairs the house. The rent is fair rental value, less any expenses that do not continue while it's unfit. Coverage E doesn't fit: Dana doesn't live there.

beats.text: So Coverage D pays the lost rent, even if repairs run past the policy's expiration.
beats.say: So Coverage D pays the lost rent, even if repairs run past the policy's expiration.

scenes.q: An owner-occupant's DP-3 home has a covered fire, and her family must stay in a hotel. Which coverage pays the necessary increase in living expenses?
scenes.why: In the dwelling forms, D is fair rental value of a rented part; E pays the insured's necessary increase in living expenses.

beats.text: Now flip it. An owner-occupant's DP-3 home burns, and her family moves into a hotel. Which coverage pays the extra living costs? Pick an answer.
beats.say: Now flip it. An owner-occupant's D P three home burns, and her family moves into a hotel. Which coverage pays the extra living costs? Pick an answer.

reveal.text: Coverage E, Additional Living Expense, because she lives there. In the DP-3, D and E together can also use up to 20% of Coverage A as additional insurance.
reveal.say: Coverage E, Additional Living Expense, because she lives there. In the D P three, D and E together can also use up to twenty percent of Coverage A as additional insurance.

reveal.text: Watch the edition: the 1988 DP-2 allowed only 10% of Coverage A.
reveal.say: Watch the edition: the nineteen eighty eight D P two allowed only ten percent of Coverage A.

scenes.title: Theft: added by endorsement
scenes.src: ISO DP 00 03 12 02, Coverage C Perils; ISO Dwelling Policy Program Manual Rule 510

columns.name: Broad Theft Coverage
points: Owner-occupied, or a tenant who is the named insured
Off-premises only if on-premises is bought
Off-premises limit no higher than on-premises

columns.name: Limited Theft Coverage
points: Non-owner-occupied, such as a landlord's rental

scenes.tell: Who lives there? The named insured lives there: Broad Theft. A landlord who doesn't: Limited Theft.

beats.text: Here's a gap. In the DP-2 and DP-3, personal property is covered for damage by burglars, but not for theft. Theft coverage is added by endorsement.
beats.say: Here's a gap. In the D P two and D P three, personal property is covered for damage by burglars, but not for theft. Theft coverage is added by endorsement.

beats.text: Broad Theft Coverage fits an owner-occupant, or a tenant who is the named insured. It covers theft on and off premises, but off-premises coverage requires on-premises coverage, at a limit no higher.
beats.say: Broad Theft Coverage fits an owner-occupant, or a tenant who is the named insured. It covers theft on and off premises, but off-premises coverage requires on-premises coverage, at a limit no higher.

beats.text: Limited Theft Coverage fits non-owner-occupied risks, like a landlord's rental. It covers theft on premises only. So choose by who lives there, not by price.
beats.say: Limited Theft Coverage fits non-owner-occupied risks, like a landlord's rental. It covers theft on premises only. So choose by who lives there, not by price.

scenes.title: DP-3 general exclusions
scenes.src: ISO DP 00 03 12 02, General Exclusions A.1–9; DP 00 03 07 14, General Exclusions A.2–A.3

items.label: Earth movement
items.detail: Ensuing fire or explosion is covered

items.label: Water damage
items.detail: Flood, sewer or drain backup, subsurface water; ensuing fire or explosion covered

items.label: Also excluded
items.detail: Ordinance or law, power failure off the location, neglect, war, nuclear hazard, governmental action

beats.text: Open perils still has exclusions, and they apply regardless of any other cause contributing to the loss.
beats.say: Open perils still has exclusions, and they apply regardless of any other cause contributing to the loss.

beats.text: Earth movement, like an earthquake, is excluded. So is water damage: flood, water backing up through sewers or drains, and subsurface water. In both, ensuing fire or explosion is covered.
beats.say: Earth movement, like an earthquake, is excluded. So is water damage: flood, water backing up through sewers or drains, and subsurface water. In both, ensuing fire or explosion is covered.

beats.text: Intentional loss is excluded too, along with ordinance or law, off-site power failure, neglect, war, nuclear hazard and governmental action.
beats.say: Intentional loss is excluded too, along with ordinance or law, off-site power failure, neglect, war, nuclear hazard and governmental action.

scenes.q: An earthquake damages a DP-3 dwelling and breaks a gas line. The resulting fire damages the dwelling further. The policy covers:
choices: Both the earthquake and the fire damage
scenes.why: Earth movement is excluded regardless of other causes, but direct loss by fire or explosion that results from it is covered.

beats.text: Try this. An earthquake damages a DP-3 dwelling and breaks a gas line. The fire that follows causes more damage. What's covered? Pick an answer.
beats.say: Try this. An earthquake damages a D P three dwelling and breaks a gas line. The fire that follows causes more damage. What's covered? Pick an answer.

reveal.text: The fire damage only. The earthquake damage is excluded as earth movement, but the ensuing fire is covered.
reveal.say: The fire damage only. The earthquake damage is excluded as earth movement, but the ensuing fire is covered.

scenes.title: Dwelling endorsements to know
scenes.src: ISO DP 04 11 12 02; DP 11 43 12 02; DL 24 01 12 02; FC&S (Aug. 12, 2024) on Special Provisions DP 01 XX

items.label: Automatic Increase in Insurance
items.detail: A and B limits rise annually by the percent shown, pro rata

items.label: Dwelling Under Construction
items.detail: Provisional A limit, times actual value over completed value

items.label: Special Provisions – Michigan
items.detail: State-mandated changes, notably cancellation and nonrenewal

items.label: Personal Liability Supplement
items.detail: Coverage L, personal liability; Coverage M, medical payments to others

beats.text: Automatic Increase in Insurance raises the Coverage A and B limits each year by the percentage shown, applied pro rata.
beats.say: Automatic Increase in Insurance raises the Coverage A and B limits each year by the percentage shown, applied pro rata.

beats.text: Dwelling Under Construction makes the Coverage A limit provisional. On any date, the insurance is that limit times actual value divided by completed value.
beats.say: Dwelling Under Construction makes the Coverage A limit provisional. On any date, the insurance is that limit times actual value divided by completed value.

beats.text: Special Provisions, Michigan, makes the state-mandated changes, notably to cancellation and nonrenewal. And the Personal Liability Supplement adds Coverages L and M.
beats.say: Special Provisions, Michigan, makes the state-mandated changes, notably to cancellation and nonrenewal. And the Personal Liability Supplement adds Coverages L and M.

items: DP-1: short named list, ACV. DP-2: 16 named perils. DP-3: open A and B
Dwelling D is fair rental value; E is additional living expense
No liability in DP forms: add the PLS for Coverages L and M
Theft by endorsement: Broad if owner-occupied, Limited if not
Earth movement and water excluded; ensuing fire is covered

beats.text: To recap. DP-1 is a short named list paid at actual cash value. DP-2 names 16 perils. DP-3 is open perils on the buildings.
beats.say: To recap. D P one is a short named list paid at actual cash value. D P two names sixteen perils. D P three is open perils on the buildings.

beats.text: In dwelling forms, D is fair rental value and E is additional living expense. Liability needs the Personal Liability Supplement.
beats.say: In dwelling forms, D is fair rental value and E is additional living expense. Liability needs the Personal Liability Supplement.

beats.text: Theft comes by endorsement, chosen by occupancy. And when an earthquake or flood causes a fire, the fire is covered.
beats.say: Theft comes by endorsement, chosen by occupancy. And when an earthquake or flood causes a fire, the fire is covered.
